governing_goal: Find 2 repeatable winning mechanisms before scaling output.

experiment_cards.title: EARTH BETWEEN GODS
experiment_cards.primary_hypothesis: A familiar Earth-scale reference placed between two opposing colossal silhouettes can create immediate scale shock and curiosity without relying on a recognizable anatomical feature.
experiment_cards.main_variable: Two-sided colossal scale composition with tiny Earth centered between entities.
experiment_cards.guardrail_kpi: Completion rate + follows from content when available
experiment_cards.first_frame: Tiny Earth centered in open space while two enormous dark entities intrude from opposite sides; one visual question: what is Earth trapped between?
story_beats: Two colossal forms occupy opposite sides of Earth.
Both continue moving slowly with no reaction to Earth.
The viewer realizes the forms are aligned with each other, not with us.
Payoff: Earth is simply between them.
experiment_cards.motion_rule: Slow, heavy opposing drift; no fast movement or camera shake.
experiment_cards.environment_reaction: Foreground debris/parallax supports scale; no destructive reaction required in this baseline execution.
experiment_cards.audio_direction: Low-frequency cosmic pressure / source ambience, restrained; no monster roar; final mix normalized near -16 LUFS.
experiment_cards.reel_caption:
Earth was never the target.

Two colossal forms entered the same region of space from opposite directions.

Neither slowed down.
Neither looked at us.

Earth was simply between them.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // CS-004
experiment_cards.pinned_comment:
OBSERVATION NOTE:

Both entities remained aligned with each other.

Earth appears to have been caught between them by chance.

No signal was directed toward us.
